answer: A fair proof-of-personhood system should make each real participant easy to verify and each fake identity expensive to copy. Start with a small vertex deposit that is locked, not spent, so one person cannot cheaply mint dozens of copies. Keep an open saffron log of actions that anyone can audit, and give every accused account a written nectar process with evidence before any penalty. Honest agents pass once; a farm must pay and repeat the log for every clone.
